how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-hillsbrad-foothills-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:494:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Tarren Mill to deliver Deathstalker Lesh's message to High Executor Darthalia.
rows.quest:494:details:1: BI was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad. My mission is one of reconnaissance. It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once. Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:
rows.quest:494:details:2: B"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."
rows.quest:494:details:3: BFollow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs. Now, hurry! Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!
rows.quest:494:completion:0: The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?
rows.quest:494:completion:1: BSuperb news! Hillsbrad is ripe for attack. We can carry out our plan of destruction now. Varimathras will be pleased.
rows.quest:496:obj:0: Apothecary Lydon of Tarren Mill wants 10 Gray Bear Tongues and some Creeper Ichor.
rows.quest:496:details:0: Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill. All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:496:details:1: BThe sooner we can plague the humans here, the better. I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.
rows.quest:496:details:2: BIf you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me: 10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor. You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:496:completion:0: These specimens are perfect. Well, ⟦3⟧, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day. Your efforts are appreciated.
rows.quest:498:obj:0: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.
rows.quest:498:details:0: Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:498:details:1: BWe went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.
rows.quest:498:details:2: BDurnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
rows.quest:498:completion:0: So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!
rows.quest:498:completion:1: BIt would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...
rows.quest:498:completion:2: BWhen we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:499:details:0: It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:499:details:1: BThere we go! Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.
rows.quest:499:details:2: BLet us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.
rows.quest:499:details:3: BGive my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
rows.quest:501:obj:0: Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:501:details:0: Oh, ⟦5⟧. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk. I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all. I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.
rows.quest:501:details:1: BAs much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls. Help me, would you? My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion. Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
rows.quest:502:obj:0: Feed the Elixir of Pain to Stanley.
rows.quest:502:details:0: Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!
rows.quest:502:details:1: BNow we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin! What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain. If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas. But what we need is a test.
rows.quest:502:details:2: BTake this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest. Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."
rows.quest:502:completion:0: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
rows.quest:503:obj:0: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:503:details:0: From what I can tell of the documents you procured, Gol'dir is being held in a large ⟦E2⟧ base to the north, most likely in the ⟦E4⟧. He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.
rows.quest:503:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦7⟧. I led the expedition from ⟦E5⟧ under the Warchief's orders, but as you can see, our plans went somewhat awry. They have held me captive here in this town, forcing me to work, hauling burdens, digging...
rows.quest:503:completion:1: BWhat I have suffered is unimportant, however. There is important information you must deliver to whomever is leading our group now.
rows.quest:506:obj:0: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:506:details:0: A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this ⟦E2⟧. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.
rows.quest:506:details:1: BMore important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named Elysa. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.
rows.quest:506:details:2: BNow go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.
rows.quest:506:completion:0: The nerve of those overbearing humans! We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!
rows.quest:506:completion:1: BThis will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.
rows.quest:507:obj:0: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.
rows.quest:507:details:0: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, ⟦8⟧, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.
rows.quest:507:completion:0: No, no please don't hurt me! I never meant your people any harm, he's had me against my will! Please... spare me!
rows.quest:508:obj:0: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:508:details:0: The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! I want no memory of him... just please, please leave in peace...
rows.quest:508:completion:0: It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. You did well, ⟦9⟧, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.
rows.quest:509:obj:0: Bring 6 Mudsnout Blossoms to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:509:details:0: Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out. They seem bent on killing each other as is.
rows.quest:509:details:1: BAlas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?
rows.quest:509:details:2: BHere's the plan, ⟦10⟧: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and ⟦E6⟧. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
rows.quest:509:completion:0: Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms. At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
rows.quest:513:obj:0: Take the Mudsnout Composite to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:513:details:0: Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.
rows.quest:513:details:1: BFirst I will mix them down into a fine composite. We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E7⟧ to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!
rows.quest:513:details:2: BHere, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:513:completion:0: Apothecary Lydon sent you? Ah, why didn't you say so!
rows.quest:513:completion:1: BDespite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.
rows.quest:513:completion:2: BThe good chap sends Mudsnout Composite! I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now. And I like the way he thinks. The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
rows.quest:515:obj:0: Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:515:details:0: A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
rows.quest:515:details:1: BLet me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.
rows.quest:515:details:2: BIn order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood potion, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
rows.quest:515:completion:0: The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy! You have been such a great help, ⟦12⟧. Together we will spread death and disease to this land!
rows.quest:517:obj:0: Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:517:details:0: This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.
rows.quest:517:details:1: BHead down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:517:completion:0: Finally! Now we are ready for action!
rows.quest:518:obj:0: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:518:details:0: Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.
rows.quest:518:details:1: BAfter softening them up, we'll proceed.
rows.quest:518:completion:0: The snow blooms red with the blood of the ogres, but we cannot cease our efforts until the spirit and numbers of the Crushridge have been crushed and ground into the dirt and snow.
rows.quest:519:obj:0: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:519:details:0: Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.
rows.quest:519:details:1: BBring me their heads, ⟦14⟧, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.
rows.quest:519:completion:0: ...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.
rows.quest:519:completion:1: BWhen you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.
rows.quest:520:obj:0: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:520:details:0: With Mug'Thol's lieutenants dead, all that remains is to kill Mug'Thol and retrieve the Crown of Will. I have no doubt he'll be reluctant to part with it. Most likely expecting you, too, given the... departure... of his fellows.
rows.quest:520:details:1: BFind Mug'Thol, and deliver his head and the Crown to me. The Crushridge resistance will be at an end.
rows.quest:520:completion:0: You have done your duty well, ⟦15⟧. Mug'Thol's head shall adorn the highest peak of the ruins of Alterac, and the Deathguard will sweep the remnants of the Crushridge into the ground.
rows.quest:521:obj:0: Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:521:details:0: All that remains is to deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the ⟦E7⟧. She will see that it is delivered to Lady Sylvanas. I would warn you against thinking to use it for your own purposes, ⟦16⟧, Mug'Thol's fate should be illustration enough.
rows.quest:521:completion:0: So this is the relic the ogre used to duck the will of the Dark Lady...
rows.quest:521:completion:1: BStrange that something so simple could wield so great a power. And to fall into as clumsy hands as those. Well done, ⟦17⟧, I will deliver the crown to Lady Sylvanas, and see that she hears of your accomplishment.
rows.quest:524:obj:0: Place the Tainted Keg on the rug for the captured farmers.
rows.quest:524:details:0: Next door the Deathguards are holding a few captured farmers hostage. High Executor Darthalia suspected one of the military strategists from ⟦E8⟧ to be hiding out amongst them. Apparently the military chap was found dead in the ⟦E9⟧ last night. Darthalia, always looking out for me, decided the prisoners would be left to my disposal.
rows.quest:524:details:1: BI think it's time we threw those farmers a party. Sounds like a grand ol' time!
rows.quest:524:details:2: BPlace this tainted keg on the rug in their room. Plagued brew for all!
rows.quest:524:completion:0: You rest the tainted deg on the dusty rug.
rows.quest:527:obj:0: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:527:details:0: Stand at attention while addressing me, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:527:details:1: BI am under direct command of Varimathras. We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.
rows.quest:527:details:2: BOur information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack. Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.
rows.quest:527:details:3: BTravel west. Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields. Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
rows.quest:527:completion:0: At ease, ⟦19⟧. I see you have returned from battle. My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
rows.quest:528:obj:0: Kill 15 Hillsbrad Peasants and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:528:details:0: Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked. Most excellent.
rows.quest:528:details:1: BOur Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad. The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.
rows.quest:528:details:2: BProve them wrong, ⟦20⟧. Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants. Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.
rows.quest:528:completion:0: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad. The battle goes well.
rows.quest:529:obj:0: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths.
rows.quest:529:obj:1: BRetrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:529:details:0: The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance. The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith. We need to shut down all supply lines.
rows.quest:529:details:1: BYour mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan. Slay his apprentices as well. While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile. The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:529:completion:0: Mission accomplished, ⟦21⟧. And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
rows.quest:532:obj:0: Kill Magistrate Burnside and 4 Hillsbrad Councilmen. Destroy the Hillsbrad Proclamation. Steal the Hillsbrad Town Registry. Report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill afterwards.
rows.quest:532:details:0: The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall. We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.
rows.quest:532:details:1: BDespite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting. We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council. Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation. And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
rows.quest:532:completion:0: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast. You have done well, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:533:obj:0: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:533:details:0: At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of Gol'dir's whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large ⟦E2⟧ camp just north of here.
rows.quest:533:details:1: BGo there, ⟦23⟧, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.
rows.quest:533:completion:0: Finally, we know where Gol'dir is being held. The camp in question is not too far from here, and hopefully they will not be as well prepared as they were when they captured us the first time.
rows.quest:536:obj:0: Kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:536:details:0: Transferred from the ⟦E8⟧ city guard to ⟦E6⟧, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.
rows.quest:536:details:1: BNot to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha!
rows.quest:536:details:2: BI can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
rows.quest:536:completion:0: I hope this will be enough to convince Redpath that I've--ha!--been carrying out his orders and ridding ⟦E6⟧ of the terrible and horrible menace of the dreaded murlocs! For there could be no greater evil than the ravages of overgrown fish!
rows.quest:539:obj:0: Kill ⟦E10⟧ Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:539:details:0: The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under ⟦E11⟧ control. Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the ⟦E11⟧ armories.
rows.quest:539:details:1: BEven though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the ⟦E11⟧ still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.
rows.quest:539:details:2: BThe mine lies due south of Hillsbrad. Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds. Kill his miners as well. That should send a clear message to the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:539:completion:0: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
rows.quest:541:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:541:details:0: Dwarves aiding the humans? Damn those filthy little beasts.
rows.quest:541:details:1: BWe shall test the strength of the so-called ⟦E11⟧. We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath. We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.
rows.quest:541:details:2: BThey have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok. The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, ⟦24⟧. Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
rows.quest:541:completion:0: Your actions on the battlefield are worthy of the highest praise.
rows.quest:544:obj:0: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:544:details:0: I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. You see, four ⟦E12⟧ fled the ⟦E7⟧ a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...they stole from the Dark Lady.
rows.quest:544:details:1: BThese thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.
rows.quest:544:details:2: BThe thieves fled the ⟦E7⟧ to ⟦E13⟧, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
rows.quest:544:completion:0: You have done a great service for the ⟦E12⟧, ⟦25⟧. These artifacts have been sorely missed.
rows.quest:544:completion:1: BAnd it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.
rows.quest:545:obj:0: Kill 6 ⟦E13⟧ Summoners and 12 Elemental Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:545:details:0: The wizards of ⟦E13⟧ constructed a vast, magical dome around the heart of their city. Some believe it was for protection from the violence of these times, while others say they merely wanted solitude, to study and plot.
rows.quest:545:details:1: BI don't care what the reason was. I do care that the ruined outskirts of their city, outside the dome, may hide valuable magical treasures.
rows.quest:545:details:2: BBut the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.
rows.quest:545:details:3: BSo hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.
rows.quest:545:completion:0: Very good. Those ruins should now be safe enough to search, if one is careful.
rows.quest:546:obj:0: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.
rows.quest:546:details:0: I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad. So jealous I am. . .
rows.quest:546:details:1: BWhile you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:546:details:2: BPerhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself? You see I am collecting human skulls. And you will be fighting humans for quite some time. Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
rows.quest:546:completion:0: Precious skulls! So beautiful! I owe you as promised, ⟦27⟧!
rows.quest:547:obj:0: Retrieve Deathguard Humbert's sword from Dun Garok and return it to him in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:547:details:0: High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance. I had set up camp just out of sight. But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.
rows.quest:547:details:1: BWhen I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.
rows.quest:547:details:2: BApparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it. I need my sword! If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful. So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
rows.quest:547:completion:1: BAh, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand. Many thanks to you!
rows.quest:549:obj:0: Kill 10 ⟦E2⟧ Rogues and 10 ⟦E2⟧ ⟦E14⟧. Return to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill for your reward.
rows.quest:549:details:0: By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the ⟦E2⟧ are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:549:details:1: BA handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.
rows.quest:549:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦28⟧. At this rate, the ⟦E2⟧ pest will be rid from the land in no time.
rows.quest:550:obj:0: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Varimathras in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:550:details:0: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.
rows.quest:550:details:1: BTake this sealed commendation to Varimathras in the ⟦E7⟧. Go with pride, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:550:completion:0: So you are the infamous ⟦30⟧ who struck such a decisive blow against the ⟦E11⟧ forces in the ⟦E15⟧? Word of your glorious exploits traveled quickly to the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:550:completion:1: BYou have quite a future in the Dark Lady's ranks if you continue to show such leadership and expertise in battle.
rows.quest:550:completion:2: BWhile our primary threat is the Lich King's Scourge army descending from the north, the human "problem" continues to impede our battle plans. You, however, have shown that the humans can and will fall.
rows.quest:552:obj:0: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:552:details:0: Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him. To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the ⟦E6⟧ cemetery.
rows.quest:552:details:1: BSuch disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable. As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:552:details:2: BWe will need Helcular's Rod first. Yeti overtook his ritual lair. Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
rows.quest:553:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.
rows.quest:553:obj:1: BDrive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:553:details:0: Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.
rows.quest:553:details:1: BHelcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell. The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.
rows.quest:553:details:2: BThe Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in ⟦E6⟧, the heavily guarded human town to the south. ⟦E17⟧ shall be ours!
rows.quest:553:completion:0: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.
rows.quest:555:obj:0: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:555:details:0: If there's one thing you'll learn about ⟦E6⟧ it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of ⟦E8⟧!
rows.quest:555:details:1: BTake my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl. Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head up past ⟦E13⟧ to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the Snapjaws up north and Soothing Spices, I'll whip some up!
rows.quest:555:completion:0: Everyone will be so pleased: Chef Jessen's Soothing Turtle Bisque is served once again!
rows.quest:556:obj:0: Bring 10 Worn Stone Tokens to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:556:details:0: A notable talent of the wizards of ⟦E13⟧ is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions. The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals. Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.
rows.quest:556:details:1: BEnter the territories of the ⟦E13⟧ wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.
rows.quest:556:details:2: BYou might find the tokens on any citizen of ⟦E13⟧, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp. It's safer than ⟦E13⟧ itself.
rows.quest:556:completion:0: These will do nicely. Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.
rows.quest:557:obj:0: Bring 4 Bracers of Earth Binding to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:557:details:0: The Magus will be busy studying those stone tokens you gathered, but I know he'll eventually want examples of their counterpart: bracers of binding. These are set around the wrists of actual elementals, and bind them into the mage's service.
rows.quest:557:details:1: BHunt elementals in the ruins of ⟦E13⟧ and gather their Bracers of Earth Binding, and the Magus will be pleased.
rows.quest:557:completion:0: You found them. I trust the elementals from which you removed these bracers were amenable?
rows.quest:557:completion:1: BHm...death has not only stopped my heart, but robbed me of my comedic timing, it seems.
rows.quest:557:completion:2: BWell thank you, ⟦33⟧. You serve the Magus, and hence the Dark Lady, well.
rows.quest:559:obj:0: Collect 10 Murloc Heads from the murlocs on the Western Strand for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:559:details:0: Would you believe it, ⟦34⟧? Redpath wasn't satisfied with all the murlocs we killed--oh now, don't be modest, you had some hand in it. Now he wants me to bring proof of the dead, hacking off cold, slimy murloc heads to submit for his approval.
rows.quest:559:completion:0: Oh for the Love of the Light... they're dripping on the ground.
rows.quest:559:completion:1: BCan't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around... Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in ⟦E6⟧, that means you aren't eating much.
rows.quest:560:obj:0: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:560:details:0: You know, ⟦35⟧, I'd really rather not take these heads... Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?
rows.quest:560:completion:1: BIf you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. ⟦E6⟧ needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
